messages:
kevin: Heads-up — BrightCart (dedicated) on a customer call, reporting p95 gen ~18-25s this morning and intermittent 5xx/429 during the morning spike. They see repeated cold spinups and some requests queueing. Can we triage quickly?
ops-bot: Alert: dedicated-probe brightcart-prod failed: attach handshake timeout=10s x5 (region=us-west2)
sara: quick q — what's configured min/max and warm-pool for that account? any recent platform rolls?
kevin: min_replicas=1, max_replicas=20, warm_pool_size=0 for that pool. We rolled runtime r12 yesterday (small perf changes). No scheduled infra maintenance.
mike: @kevin copying logs — controller shows repeated attach auth errors then spawn timeouts. snippet:```2026-02-26T08:12:03Z controller attach failed: rpc error: code=Unauthenticated desc="token invalid"
2026-02-26T08:12:09Z spawn: pod init start
2026-02-26T08:12:31Z spawn: imagepullbackoff
2026-02-26T08:12:45Z attach timeout exceeded
```
julie: infra side — registry pull metrics show a short bucket of 429s from our image registry in us-west2 around 08:10-08:15, and one node group had kubelet pull retries. Could be imagepull + service-account rotation overlap.
anita: Customer notes they rotated a service account key at ~02:00AM last night via console. They suspected nothing would break but saw traffic first thing this morning.
mike: That matches: if attach uses a short-lived token that depended on the rotated key, we can see intermittent Unauthorized until the attach-controller refreshes creds. That + cold image pulls explains the 18-25s p95.
kevin: Repro I ran from our loadbench (small script):```for i in {1..200}; do curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood/v1/generate" -d '{"model":"r12-large","prompt":"hi"}' & done; wait``` Result: first ~30-50 requests either 5xx or 429, then system scaled and responses stabilize ~200ms.
julie: Mitigation applied: bumped min_replicas to 3 for brightcart-prod, restarted attach-controller to force token refresh, and enabled fallback routing to smaller model variant while we investigate. p95 dropped to ~3s within 6 minutes.
kevin: Customer confirmed improvement on the call and is monitoring. Next actions: eng-runtime (mike) to investigate auth refresh edge-case with r12, eng-infra (julie) to audit registry/rotation grace windows, support (kevin/anita) to keep customer updated and draft PM. Owner assignments: mike, julie.
mike: I'll capture timeline + exact repro, link logs, and open ENG-5372.
kevin: Thanks team — leaving this thread open until we have a short postmortem and a config fix (token grace + warm-pool recommendation).
